features.title: Everything you need to stay in Japanese.
features.subtitle: Move from understanding what you read to remembering what matters, with tools designed to work together.

media.title: Read and watch with furigana
media.description: Explore manga, video subtitles and NHK Easy with dictionary lookups, reading support and context ready for review.

notebook.title: A notebook that understands Japanese
notebook.description: Write in TipTap, inspect morphology and syntax, catch common particle mistakes, and estimate passage familiarity with offline MorphMan.

shadowing.title: Listen, repeat, improve
shadowing.description: Practice shadowing with your own audio and native system text-to-speech, keeping listening close to active study.

srs.title: Reviews tuned to memory
srs.description: FSRS and SM-2 scheduling work with relational decks in local SQLite, bringing vocabulary back when it is due.

morphman.title: Know what you know
morphman.description: Analyze vocabulary coverage and estimated retention against your local cards before you dive into a passage.

kana.title: Build kana fluency
kana.description: Train hiragana and katakana with quick drills and character-level mastery tracking.

insights.title: See the practice behind your progress.
insights.subtitle: YomiFlow brings focus time, recall and consistency into view, so you can shape a sustainable study rhythm.
